question: How do I track my order status?
answer: You can track your order by navigating to 'My Account' > 'Orders' and clicking 'Track Package'. You will also receive an SMS and email with live carrier tracking links upon dispatch.

question: What are the standard delivery timeframes and shipping fees?
answer: Standard shipping takes 3-5 business days and is free on orders above $50. Express shipping takes 1-2 business days for a flat rate of $9.99.

When will I receive my items?

question: Can I modify or cancel my order after placing it?
answer: You can cancel or modify your order within 60 minutes of placing it from the 'My Orders' dashboard. After 60 minutes, processing begins and you may return the items upon receipt instead.

Can I change the delivery address?

question: What is your return policy?
answer: We offer a 30-day hassle-free return policy for items in their original condition and packaging with original tags attached.
sample_queries: Can I return an opened item?

question: How long does it take to receive my refund?
answer: Once our fulfillment center inspects your returned package, refunds are initiated within 3-5 business days. Bank processing to your original payment method may take an additional 2-7 business days.
sample_queries: When will I get my refund?

question: How do I exchange an item for a different size or color?
answer: To initiate an exchange, go to 'My Orders' > 'Return/Exchange', select the desired replacement size or color, and print your prepaid return label.
sample_queries: Can I exchange for a larger size?
How do I replace a product?

question: What payment methods do you accept?
answer: We accept Visa, MasterCard, American Express, PayPal, Apple Pay, Google Pay, and Klarna / Afterpay installments.

question: Is my payment information and credit card secure?
answer: Yes. All transactions are encrypted with 256-bit SSL encryption and processed via PCI-DSS Level 1 certified gateways. We never store raw card numbers on our servers.
sample_queries: Is payment safe on this site?
How secure is my billing information?

question: Why was my payment declined?
answer: Common reasons include mismatched billing ZIP codes, insufficient funds, or automated anti-fraud security blocks by your bank. We suggest checking billing details or contacting your bank.

question: How do I reset my account password?
answer: Click 'Sign In', select 'Forgot Password?', enter your registered email address, and follow the password reset link sent to your inbox.

question: How do I enable Two-Factor Authentication (2FA)?
answer: Go to 'Account Settings' > 'Security' > 'Two-Factor Authentication' and scan the QR code using Google Authenticator, Authy, or Microsoft Authenticator.

question: How do I update my profile details and shipping addresses?
answer: Navigate to 'Account' > 'Address Book & Profile' to update your name, contact phone number, default shipping addresses, and communication preferences.

question: How do I contact customer support or speak to a live human agent?
answer: You can reach our 24/7 customer care team via live chat in the bottom right corner, email us at support@example.com, or call toll-free at 1-800-555-0199.

question: What should I do if I received a damaged or defective item?
answer: We sincerely apologize! Please visit 'My Orders' > 'Report Issue', attach a photo of the damaged product within 7 days of delivery, and we will dispatch a free replacement immediately.

question: Do you ship internationally?
answer: Yes! We ship to over 100 countries worldwide. International shipping rates and estimated customs duties will be calculated at checkout based on your destination country.

question: What is this AI FAQ Assistant and how does it work?
answer: This FAQ Assistant is an AI-driven conversational agent developed for CodeAlpha Task 2. It utilizes Natural Language Processing (tokenization, lemmatization) and TF-IDF vectorization with Cosine Similarity to find the most accurate answer for your questions.
sample_queries: Tell me about this AI assistant

question: What technologies power this FAQ Chatbot?
answer: This chatbot is built using Python, NLTK for text preprocessing, Scikit-learn for TF-IDF Vectorization and Cosine Similarity, and Streamlit for an interactive conversational UI.
